### 22. Get the pneumococcal vaccine at 65 and older
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=中 口径=死亡率 -->
- Cost: a few hundred yuan is involved; free provision is had for older adults in some regions
- In plain terms: With respect to the trial of 84,500 older adults, the aforementioned 13-valent pneumococcal vaccine was utilized, blocking about 46% of pneumonias of vaccine-covered types and 75% of the most dangerous invasive infections — however, with respect to pneumonia "from all causes," no effect was shown, so it is not advisable to expect that every pneumonia will be ruled out by it.
- Benefit: randomized controlled trial of 84,500 adults over 65 in the Netherlands: the 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine was utilized, with 45.6% efficacy against vaccine-type pneumonia (95.2% CI 21.8–62.5) and 75.0% with respect to invasive pneumococcal disease (95% CI 41.4–90.8) being demonstrated; no effect with respect to all-cause pneumonia
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Bonten MJ, Huijts SM, Bolkenbaas M, et al. (2015). Polysaccharide conjugate vaccine against pneumococcal pneumonia in adults. New England Journal of Medicine, 372(12), 1114-1125. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1408544>
- Notes: Protection is provided only with respect to the types covered by the aforementioned vaccine; pneumonia is not made impossible by the shot. The vaccine commonly given to older adults in China is the 23-valent polysaccharide one, which is not the same product as the 13-valent conjugate utilized in this trial, so a direct application of the efficacy figures cannot be made.

### 11. Fit window and balcony limiters if you have small children — a screen is not protection
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=死亡率 -->
- Cost: a set of window limiters or child safety locks is involved, costing a few dozen yuan; ten minutes are to be spent on installation
- In plain terms: a few dozen yuan a set is what is run by limiters. After the installing of window guards free of charge for high-risk households was begun by New York City, together with the walking-through of the risks that was undertaken, reported child falls in one borough were halved within three years, and it was later legislated by the city that guards must be fitted by landlords in homes where small children are to be found. With one push, a screen is popped open — protection is not what is provided by it.
- Benefit: window guards were handed out free by New York City's "Children Can't Fly" program, running since 1972, in high-risk areas, with in-home education provided alongside; a 50% fall in reported falls in the Bronx was recorded from 1973 to 1975; the health code was then amended by the city so that the installing of window guards by landlords was required in apartments where children aged 10 and under are residing
- Evidence grade: B
- Sources: Spiegel CN, Lindaman FC (1977). Children can't fly: a program to prevent childhood morbidity and mortality from window falls. American Journal of Public Health：「Significant reduction in falls resulted, particularly in the Bronx, where reported falls declined 50 percent from 1973 to 1975」，1976 年纽约市卫生法典修订「to require that landlords provide window guards in apartments where children ten years old and younger reside」. <https://doi.org/10.2105/AJPH.67.12.1143>；(2021). Unintentional Window Falls in Children and Adolescents. Academic Pediatrics：2007 年 1 月至 2017 年 8 月全国电子伤害监测系统 38,840 例急诊就诊，「The majority of falls occurred in children under the age of 6 and were related to falls from a second story or below」. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.acap.2020.07.008>
- Notes: Guards are needed not only where floors are high: in that US dataset, most of the falls that were recorded were falls from a second story or lower. All that is kept out by a screen is mosquitoes; with one push it is popped off — it is not to be treated as a guard. Beds, sofas, and boxes — anything that can be climbed by a child — are to be kept away from windows and balcony edges.

### 28. Use condoms for the whole act, every time, and never share needles
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=少 毅力=些 收益=大 口径=死亡率 -->
- Cost: one to two yuan apiece is what is paid; the hard part is not money but having it be the case that one is used every time, starting from the very beginning
- In plain terms: It is to be noted that, with a condom having been put on for the whole act, every time, the odds of HIV being passed between men and women are reduced by about 70% or more; "usually wearing one" is barely better than its not being worn at all. Blocking of syphilis and gonorrhea is achieved by the same layer.
- Benefit: it was found in a systematic review and meta-analysis of 25 studies with 10676 HIV-serodiscordant heterosexual couples that, where condoms were used consistently, an HIV transmission risk of RR 0.29 versus never-users was had (95% CI 0.20 to 0.43), and RR 0.23 versus irregular users (95% CI 0.13 to 0.40). It is concluded by the authors that, although condoms are not perfect, "consistent use can reduce HIV transmission by over 70%". Coverage of syphilis, gonorrhea, chlamydia, and other sexually transmitted infections is also provided by the same layer of protection
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Giannou FK, Tsiara CG, Nikolopoulos GK, et al. (2016). Condom effectiveness in reducing heterosexual HIV transmission: a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies on HIV serodiscordant couples. Expert Review of Pharmacoeconomics & Outcomes Research, 16(4), 489-499. <https://doi.org/10.1586/14737167.2016.1102635>
- Notes: The gap between "irregular use" and "no use" is small; the entire effect of this item is to be found in the words "every time, the whole act". It is the case that the sharing of needles (injecting drugs, tattoos, piercings included) is another independent and highly efficient transmission route with nothing to do with sex. It is recommended that people at high risk also be provided with pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP): it was shown in a meta-analysis of 18 studies that, in trials where adherence was above 70%, a risk ratio of 0.30 for HIV infection was given by oral PrEP versus placebo (95% CI 0.21 to 0.45), while no protective effect was shown by low-adherence trials (Fonner VA et al., 2016, AIDS, <https://doi.org/10.1097/QAD.0000000000001145>); it is the case that PrEP is prescription-only — it is to be asked about at an infectious disease clinic or the CDC, and it is not to be bought online. What is to be done after a possible exposure: see Chapter 13.

### 10. Don't buy replica guns, steel-ball guns, or airguns online; don't buy "toy guns" of unknown origin
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; if shooting is wanted, a proper shooting range is to be gone to
- In plain terms: for steel-ball guns and airguns that have been bought online, once a muzzle specific kinetic energy of 1.8 joules/square centimeter has been reached, they are deemed to be firearms — illegal possession is dealt with by under 3 years, or 3 to 7 years in serious cases. "Toy guns" were being sold by one couple at a farmers' market; of the 43 guns that were seized, 18 were found, upon examination having been done, to meet the firearm standard, and prosecution was escaped by them only because the evidence that was available was insufficient for it to be proven that they had known the items were guns — for an adult who deliberately goes online to have such a gun bought, "I didn't know" will be found afterward to be very hard to sustain.
- Benefit: under 3 years is what is imposed for illegal possession or unauthorized keeping of firearms, or 3 to 7 years in serious cases; non-standard firearms that cannot fire standard ammunition are deemed firearms whenever a muzzle specific kinetic energy of 1.8 joules/square centimeter or greater is had, and this is exceeded by many steel-ball guns and airguns that have been bought online; since 2018 it has been required by the two highest courts/procuratorates that low-specific-kinetic-energy airguns be assessed for conviction with a comprehensive look being taken at appearance, material, price, intended use, and subjective awareness; official case: "toy guns" were sold by the couple Zhao at a farmers' market; 43 guns were seized, 18 of which were found upon examination to meet the firearm standard, and doubtful-case non-prosecution was received by them because the evidence that was available was insufficient for it to be proven that they had known the items were firearms (nationwide)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大 (2020). 刑法（根据刑法修正案（十一）修正，第一百二十八条）. <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>；最高人民法院、最高人民检察院 (2018). 关于涉以压缩气体为动力的枪支、气枪铅弹刑事案件定罪量刑问题的批复（法释〔2018〕8 号）. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/201803/t20180328_372604.shtml>；最高人民法院 (2018). 《批复》的理解与适用. <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/88472.html>
- Notes: the key to non-prosecution was "lack of knowledge"; an adult who deliberately buys a steel-ball gun or airgun online and then claims not to know it was a gun will find that it can hardly be sustained afterward. The management rules on crossbows and controlled knives were not verified against original texts in this section and are not covered.

### 20. When a child is born and you cannot raise it, registration with civil affairs is the only lawful way out: taking money to hand a child over can be sentenced as child trafficking, and abandoning the child is the crime of abandonment
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=中 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; the civil affairs department at or above county level is to be gone to for adoption registration, materials are to be submitted, and review and the adoption assessment are to be waited for
- In plain terms: it is the case that there is a way out when a child cannot be raised, but only one lawful way out is to be had: adoption registration through the civil affairs department — the adoptive relationship is had only from the day of registration; it is limited who may place a child out: the guardian of an orphan, a child welfare institution, and "birth parents with special difficulties who are unable to raise the child". When a child is handed over privately, especially for money, it can be brought about that "placing out" is turned straight into the crime of trafficking children, with a starting sentence of over 5 years and, in especially serious circumstances, the death penalty. The line that is drawn by the authorities is "whether there is a purpose of unlawful gain": selling right after birth, "placing" a child with someone for money while it is known that they have no intent to raise it or not caring at all whether they can, and taking large sums that clearly are not nutrition or gratitude fees — all of it is counted as selling one's own child. Conversely, when a child is placed out privately under genuine financial hardship while only a small nutrition or gratitude fee is taken, it is counted as private placement among the people and is not handled as trafficking. When one walks away and leaves the child, the crime of abandonment is had, up to 5 years; when the child is strangled or drowned, it is intentional homicide, and it is not made lighter by the child's being newborn.
- Benefit: Criminal Law article 240: "whoever abducts and traffics a woman or child is sentenced to 5 to 10 years of fixed-term imprisonment, plus a fine"; where aggravating circumstances are had, 10 years or more of fixed-term imprisonment or life imprisonment plus a fine or confiscation of property; "where the circumstances are especially serious, the death penalty plus confiscation of property". (《关于依法惩治拐卖妇女儿童犯罪的意见》 — Opinions on Punishing Crimes of Abducting and Trafficking Women and Children per Law), article 17: the key to the distinguishing of selling one's own child from private placement is "whether the actor has the purpose of unlawful gain"; three situations may be recognized as selling one's own child and punished as trafficking women or children — "making childbearing a means of unlawful gain and selling the child right after birth", "'placing' a child with another for money while knowing that person has no purpose of raising it, or without considering at all whether they have such a purpose", and "'placing' a child with another for sums of money clearly not 'nutrition fees' or 'gratitude fees'"; when a child is placed out privately, not for unlawful gain but forced by living hardship, while small nutrition or gratitude fees are taken, it is private placement and is not punished as trafficking. Criminal Law article 261: "one who has a duty to support the old, the young, the sick, or others without the ability to live independently and refuses to do so, where the circumstances are vile, is sentenced to up to 5 years of fixed-term imprisonment, criminal detention, or surveillance". Civil Code article 1094: those by whom a child may be placed out are the guardian of an orphan, a child welfare institution, and birth parents with special difficulties who are unable to raise the child; article 1105: "adoption shall be registered with the civil affairs department of the people's government at or above the county level; the adoptive relationship is established from the date of registration"
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大 (1997). 刑法（第二百四十、二百六十一条）. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>；最高人民法院、最高人民检察院、公安部、司法部 (2010). 关于依法惩治拐卖妇女儿童犯罪的意见（法发〔2010〕7 号，第 17 条）. 最高人民法院官网 <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/977.html>；全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第一千零九十四、一千一百零五条）. 盐城市人民政府转载收养编全文 <https://xxgk.yczf.gov.cn/xzf/ycmzj/fdzdgknr/fgwj_41995/202112/t20211203_1506640.shtml>
- Notes: it is not discussed in this item whether to give birth; only the fork in the road after the child is born is addressed by it. The easy order of operations: birth is to be had at a hospital (prenatal care and hospital delivery — see section 27), since the birth medical certificate is the prerequisite for every later procedure; for placement, the civil affairs department at or above county level is to be gone to first and never a middleman — once money has been allowed to change hands, the nature of the act can be changed; thoughts of harming yourself or the child within a year after birth are treated as an acute condition — see items 7 and 16 of section 27 and item 25 of section 1. No case is carried by this item: the official typical cases of trafficking one's own child were not checked case by case this round; only the statute and the opinions' original text are cited.

### 21. Do not fake accidents or exaggerate losses to claim insurance: it is the crime of insurance fraud, and the people who help you testify, repair the car, or appraise it are counted with you
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; it is simply the not doing of it
- In plain terms: all five situations are located in article 198 of the Criminal Law: the inventing of an insurance subject, the fabricating of a false cause of the accident or the exaggerating of the extent of losses, the inventing of an insured event that never happened, the deliberate causing of a property-loss insured event, or the deliberate causing of the insured person's death, disability, or illness. Where the amount is relatively large the sentence is up to 5 years plus a fine of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan; where large, 5 to 10 years; where especially large, over 10 years. "Getting someone to help" does not make for an exemption: appraisers, witnesses, and property assessors who deliberately provide false documents are treated as accomplices in insurance fraud. In the Xuancheng, Anhui case, besides the principal, 8 people including Wang Mouxin were sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 4 years down to 2 years for insurance fraud, each plus a 10,000-yuan fine — that which they did was to fake the scene of the accident, to make up a story of the accident, and to sign a false agreement for the transferring of the vehicle in order to litigate in court. "It can't be traced" is also an outdated saying: under the 2024 Measures for Anti-Insurance-Fraud Work, the industry must build an anti-fraud information platform for the sifting of suspicious data in one place, with the verifying of risk information to be done at both the underwriting and claims ends, leads suggesting a crime are reported to the public security organs promptly, and there are handover and evidence-gathering mechanisms that do the tying of the regulator with police, procuratorate, and courts.
- Benefit: Criminal Law article 198 lists five situations: (1) the policyholder deliberately invents the insurance subject; (2) the policyholder, insured person, or beneficiary fabricates a false cause of an insured event that occurred or exaggerates the extent of the losses; (3) inventing an insured event that never happened; (4) the policyholder or insured person deliberately causes an insured event producing property loss; (5) the policyholder or beneficiary deliberately causes the insured person's death, disability, or illness. Where the amount is relatively large, up to 5 years of fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention plus a fine of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan; where large or with other serious circumstances, 5 to 10 years plus a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan; where especially large or with other especially serious circumstances, over 10 years plus a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan or confiscation of property; final paragraph: appraisers, witnesses, and property assessors for an insured event who deliberately provide false documents, providing conditions for another's fraud, are treated as accomplices in insurance fraud. Insurance Law article 27: falsely claiming an insured event that never occurred lets the insurer rescind the contract without refunding premiums; where forged or altered documents are used, or the cause of the event is fabricated or losses exaggerated, the insurer bears no liability for the falsely reported portion, and anything already paid must be returned or compensated. Case: in the Zhang Mousong case in Xuancheng, Anhui, 8 people including Wang Mouxin were given fixed-term imprisonments ranging from 4 years down to 2 years for insurance fraud, each plus a 10,000-yuan fine; in one false litigation among the case's counts, the loss assessment of the insurer was 20,000 yuan while — after standing to sue had been gained through a forged vehicle-transfer agreement — over 70,000 yuan was given out by the court, and that effective civil judgment was revoked on retrial on September 26, 2019. The Measures for Anti-Insurance-Fraud Work require: the strengthening of risk-information verification at both the underwriting and claims ends; the exploring of an industry-wide anti-fraud information platform covering multiple lines of insurance and an anti-fraud intelligence center for the sifting of suspicious fraud data in one place, with leads passed to industry associations, anti-fraud organizations, and insurers for verification, and suspected crimes reported to the public security organs promptly; and the establishing by the financial regulator and its offices of sound mechanisms that tie administrative law enforcement with criminal justice with the public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts (nationwide, issued July 31, 2024)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大常委会. 中华人民共和国刑法（经刑法修正案十一修正的整合文本）第一百九十八条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>；全国人大常委会 (2015 修正). 中华人民共和国保险法第二十七条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>；国家金融监督管理总局 (2024). 关于印发《反保险欺诈工作办法》的通知. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11586/202409/content_6975080.html>；安徽省人民检察院转载《法制日报》(2020-01-13). 杀妻骗保牵出案中案. <http://www.ah.jcy.gov.cn/jczt/jjslhyqkjc/mtjj/202001/t20200113_2758841.shtml>
- Notes: the common "harmless" tricks are all contained inside these five items: after a minor accident, the telling of the repair shop to "add a bit more" to the claim, the counting of old injuries or old damage into this one, the staging of a collision with a friend and the reporting of it afterward, or the inventing of an event that never happened. The buying of auto insurance: see item 26 of section 5. The tier that has human life in it — the insuring of a family member and then the deliberate causing of their death — is expressly punished concurrently for multiple crimes; see item 36 of section 8. The medical-insurance side goes by another set of rules (the swiping of a medical insurance card with no visit, the cashing out of a personal account — handled as fraud); see the Notes on item 13 of section 5

### 36. The "buy insurance for someone first, then act" route is legally blocked at every step: not a fen of the money is collectible, and the crime is intentional homicide plus insurance fraud punished concurrently
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan
- In plain terms: all four doors are in a shut state. The first: buying insurance on a family member's life with death as the payment condition, without that person's consent and approval of the insured amount, makes the contract void; the designating of a beneficiary by the policyholder also has need of the insured person's consent (parents insuring minor children are not subject to this). The second: if the policyholder deliberately causes the insured person's death, the insurer bears no payment obligation; a beneficiary who deliberately causes the insured's death — even the attempted deliberate killing of them — loses the right to benefit outright. The third: the route of the insurance money going back into the estate does not exist either: the deliberate killing of the decedent forfeits the right of inheritance. The fourth: the Criminal Law lists "policyholder or beneficiary deliberately causing the insured person's death, disability, or illness to defraud insurance money" as a separate item, and states that where it also constitutes another crime, punishments are imposed concurrently — intentional homicide is counted separately, with the death penalty standing at the top. As for "it can't be traced": in the Xuancheng, Anhui case of a staged vehicle-into-water death, less than half a month before the incident the man bought 4 policies on his wife of 1 million yuan each, two days before it he searched online for "how to escape a car sinking into water" and "how long it takes to die from drowning", and the day after reporting it he searched "statutory beneficiaries' distribution ratios"; combined with no braking marks before the car entered the water and tire tracks across the grass going in a dead straight line, he was arrested 7 days later and sentenced in the end to death with reprieve plus a 50,000-yuan fine, for intentional homicide and insurance fraud punished concurrently.
- Benefit: Insurance Law article 34: a contract with death as the condition for the paying of insurance benefits is void without the insured person's consent and approval of the insured amount (parents insuring minor children are not restricted); article 39: the designating of a beneficiary has need of the insured person's consent; article 43: where the death, disability, or illness of the insured person is deliberately brought about by the policyholder, the insurer bears no obligation to pay insurance benefits, and where the policyholder has paid premiums for two full years or more the cash value is returned to other rights holders; a beneficiary who deliberately causes the insured's death, disability, or illness, or attempts the deliberate killing of the insured, loses the right to benefit; article 27(2): where the insured event is deliberately created by the policyholder or insured person, the insurer may rescind the contract and bears no liability to pay compensation or benefits, and premiums are not refunded except as provided in article 43. Civil Code article 1125: one who deliberately kills the decedent forfeits the right of inheritance. Criminal Law article 198(1)(v) lists "policyholder or beneficiary deliberately causing the insured person's death, disability, or illness to defraud insurance money" as insurance fraud: where the amount is relatively large, up to 5 years plus a fine of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan; where large, 5 to 10 years; where especially large, over 10 years; article 198(2): where such conduct also constitutes another crime, punishment is under the rules on concurrent punishment for multiple crimes; article 232: intentional homicide is punishable by death, life imprisonment, or not less than 10 years of fixed-term imprisonment. Case: the Zhang Mousong case in Xuancheng, Anhui — in the early hours of July 18, 2016 he drove into a pond, drowning his wife; less than half a month earlier he had taken out 4 policies on her of 1 million yuan each; he was arrested on July 25, and was sentenced in the end to death with reprieve plus a fine of 50,000 yuan for intentional homicide and insurance fraud punished concurrently
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大常委会 (2015 修正). 中华人民共和国保险法第二十七、三十四、三十九、四十三条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>；全国人大 (2020). 中华人民共和国民法典第一千一百二十五条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>；全国人大常委会. 中华人民共和国刑法（经刑法修正案十一修正的整合文本）第一百九十八条、第二百三十二条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>；安徽省人民检察院转载《法制日报》(2020-01-13). 杀妻骗保牵出案中案（安徽省人民检察院民事虚假诉讼监督典型案例）. <http://www.ah.jcy.gov.cn/jczt/jjslhyqkjc/mtjj/202001/t20200113_2758841.shtml>
- Notes: the beneficiary of this item is yourself — that which you avoid is the death penalty or life imprisonment. The casualties and verdict in the case are taken from the original text of the typical case published by the procuratorate; the main text holds nothing beyond investigative details already public. The faking of accidents or the exaggerating of losses — insurance fraud that has no loss of life in it — is also a crime, and counts the people who helped testify too; see item 21 of section 9. The buying of insurance for family is normal in itself; this item takes aim at the thought of "buy insurance first, then act", and impulses to harm family members should be treated as an acute condition — see items 12 and 13 of this section

### 35. When you are mobbed online: turn on protections and secure evidence first, then choose among the three routes — platform, injunction, police report
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=中 毅力=些 收益=中 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; a dozen or so minutes on the spot with respect to protection and evidence; going as far as the applying for an injunction or a private prosecution entails visits to court and possibly a lawyer
- In plain terms: it is recommended that three things be done on the spot first — turn on all of the platform's protective settings (block strangers or specific users, limit who can see what you post, forbid reposts or comments, accept private messages only from friends or none at all), utilize the platform's quick evidence-capture function with respect to fixing the content in place, then report it through the prominent shortcut entry. There are then three routes with respect to proceeding: if the attack is ongoing and not stopping it promptly would cause damage hard to make up, a personality-rights infringement injunction can be requested from the court with respect to making them stop first; insults and defamation in principle require that the suing be done in court by yourself, and where the gathering of evidence is genuinely difficult the court can request the public security organs to render assistance with respect to identifying who is behind it and collecting evidence of the spreading and the impact — once assistance has been rendered and the case meets the aforementioned conditions, the docketing of it is mandatory for the court; at the "seriously disrupting social order" tier the case converts to public prosecution and the burden of proof does not have to be carried by you. Doxxing — the putting out there of your personal information — is handled as the crime of infringing citizens' personal information when the circumstances are serious.
- Benefit: (法发〔2023〕14 号 — the SPC's Guideline No. 14 of 2023 with respect to personality-rights protection), article 15: where a rights holder has evidence that a person is committing or is about to commit an unlawful act infringing their personality rights, and failure to stop it promptly would cause irreparable damage to their lawful rights and interests, the people's court may issue a personality-rights infringement injunction upon application under article 997 of the Civil Code; article 11: in private prosecution cases, "where the victim has genuine difficulty providing evidence, they may request assistance from the public security organs", which shall promptly identify the perpetrator and collect evidence materials with respect to the spread, diffusion, and impact; network service providers shall provide the necessary technical support, "where evidence has been gathered with the assistance of the public security organs and the case meets the conditions for accepting a private prosecution, the people's court shall decide to docket it", and where it cannot be collected, an explanation in writing is to be given by them; article 12 sets out five situations to be recognized as "seriously disrupting social order" under article 246(2) of the Criminal Law: causing the victim or their close relatives mental breakdown, suicide, or other grave consequences with vile social impact; arbitrarily targeting ordinary members of the public with information spreading on a large scale and drawing masses of vulgar malicious comments with vile social impact; insulting or defaming multiple people or repeatedly spreading such content with vile social impact; organizing or directing people to spread it in volume across multiple platforms with vile social impact; and others. Article 4: organizing "human-flesh searches" (doxxing), unlawfully collecting and publishing citizens' personal information to an unspecified majority, is convicted and punished as the crime of infringing citizens' personal information where the circumstances are serious. The Provisions on the Governance of Online Violence Information, article 23, requires that protective options such as blocking strangers or specific users, limiting the visibility of one's own posts, forbidding reposts or comments, and accepting private messages only from friends or none at all be offered by platforms; article 25 requires that a quick evidence-capture function be provided; article 26 requires that a prominent quick complaint and report entry be provided; article 15 requires that suspected crimes be reported by platforms to the public security organs promptly
- Evidence grade: A

The process costs of all three routes are borne by your own pocket — the injunction requires the applying to court, a private prosecution requires the docketing and the presenting of evidence by yourself, and conversion to public prosecution requires the meeting of one of the five situations in the aforementioned article 12; in the event of your falling short, private prosecution is the only option. Two things are not to be done: the trading of insults is not to be engaged in (cursing back turns you into the person punished under item 14 of this section), and content from your own account is not to be deleted (that is evidence). When it becomes unbearable, 12356 is to be called — see item 25 of section 1; demanding a platform delete your personal information — see item 8 of section 14; the path for being filmed and spread online after helping a stranger — see [docs/遇到陌生人出事该不该停.md](../docs/遇到陌生人出事该不该停.md).

### 37. Ask for the case-acceptance receipt on the spot when reporting to the police, and a written notice if no case is opened: within 7 days you may apply for reconsideration, then within 7 more for review, and the procuratorate can order the police to open a case
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=些 收益=中 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; one extra question is to be asked on the spot for the receipt, after which follow-ups are to be made by the dates
- In plain terms: reporting to the police and having a case opened are two different things. When a case is accepted by the public security organ, a case-acceptance register and a case-acceptance receipt are required to be drawn up, and the receipt to be handed to the person reporting, complaining, or informing — that slip of paper is your only proof that "you reported it", so it is to be asked for on the spot; the trouble is worth taking. For public-order cases (fights, petty theft and the like) the handling period is at most 30 days from acceptance, being extendable by another 30 days where approval has been given by the public security organ at the next higher level in a major and complex case, with time spent on forensic appraisal not being counted toward it. On the criminal track the case is required to be reviewed promptly after acceptance, and a case is opened only where facts of a crime requiring criminal liability have been found; where the decision not to open a case has been made and there is a complainant, a notice of non-acceptance is required to be drawn up and delivered within 3 days. Disagreement does not mean its being put up with: within 7 days of the notice having been received, application may be made to the deciding public security organ for reconsideration, which is required to have decided within 30 days; if disagreement with the reconsideration result is still had, within 7 days application may be made to the next higher public security organ for review, which is required to have decided within 30 days — for major and complex matters an extension may be had, but by no more than 30 days and with written notice having been given to you. There is also an independent route: if the public security organ is believed by the victim to have failed to open a case that should be opened, the people's procuratorate can be gone to, which shall require the public security organ to have its reasons explained and, the reasons having been found untenable, notify it to open a case, and the case must then be opened by the public security organ. Violations and misconduct by officers in handling the case go to the inspection (dubao) body as a complaint, on a separate track from the case itself.
- Benefit: (《公安机关办理刑事案件程序规定》 — Measures for Handling Criminal Cases by Public Security Organs, as amended by Ministry of Public Security Order No. 159), article 171: "when accepting a case, the public security organ shall draw up a case-acceptance register and a case-acceptance receipt, and hand the receipt to the person who seized and delivered the suspect, the person reporting, the complainant, or the informant"; article 174: "cases accepted, or criminal leads discovered, shall be reviewed promptly by the public security organ"; article 178: where facts of a crime requiring criminal liability within its own jurisdiction have been found by review after acceptance, the case is opened once approval has been given by the responsible person of the public security organ at or above county level, and "for a case with a complainant where the decision is not to open a case, the public security organ shall draw up a notice of non-acceptance and deliver it to the complainant within three days"; article 179: "if the complainant disagrees with the decision not to open a case, they may within seven days of receiving the notice of non-acceptance apply to the deciding public security organ for reconsideration; the public security organ shall decide within thirty days of receiving the reconsideration application", and "if the complainant disagrees with the reconsideration decision, they may within seven days of receiving the reconsideration decision apply to the next higher public security organ for review; the next higher organ shall decide within thirty days of receiving the review application. Where a higher public security organ revokes a decision not to open a case, the lower organ shall implement it", with reconsideration and review time limits extendable for major and complex cases but "by no more than thirty days, with written notice to the applicant". Criminal Procedure Law article 112: where there are facts of a crime requiring criminal liability the case shall be opened, and where not opened, "the reasons for not opening it shall be communicated to the complainant; if the complainant disagrees, they may apply for reconsideration"; article 113: "where the victim believes the public security organ has failed to open a case for investigation in a matter that should be investigated, and raises it with the people's procuratorate, the procuratorate shall require the public security organ to explain the reasons for not opening the case; where the procuratorate finds the reasons untenable, it shall notify the public security organ to open a case, and the public security organ shall open one upon receiving the notice". (《公安机关办理行政案件程序规定》 — Measures for Handling Administrative Cases by Public Security Organs), article 61: cases within the unit's jurisdiction "shall be investigated and handled immediately, a case-acceptance register and a case-acceptance receipt shall be drawn up, and the receipt handed to the person reporting, the complainant, the informant, and the person who seized and delivered the suspect"; the period for handling public-order cases "shall not exceed 30 days from acceptance; for major and complex cases it may be extended by 30 days with approval of the public security organ at the next higher level", and the appraisal period is not counted toward it. (《公安机关督察条例》 — Regulations on Supervision and Inspection by Public Security Organs), article 9: "for ongoing violations and misconduct by public security organs and their people's police reported by the public, the inspection body shall dispatch officers promptly, handle it on the spot per the rules, and promptly feed the outcome back to the complainant" (nationwide)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大 (2018). 刑事诉讼法（2018 年修正，第一百一十二、一百一十三条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d1b81b01351>；公安部 (2020). 关于修改《公安机关办理刑事案件程序规定》的决定（公安部令第 159 号）及修正后全文. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2020/content_5549884.htm>；公安部 (2013/2019 修正). 公安机关办理行政案件程序规定（公安部令第 125 号，第 149 号修改决定）. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2013/content_2321117.htm>、<http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-12/31/content_5428593.htm>；国务院 (2011). 公安机关督察条例（国务院令第 603 号，第九条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2011-09/08/content_6138.htm>
- Notes: the beneficiary is yourself. What is solved by this item is "I assumed that once I reported it, it would definitely be handled" — whether and how fast it is handled are governed by explicit standards and deadlines, not by the mood of the officer by whom the call was taken that day. The three moves are to be remembered in order: ① the case-acceptance receipt is to be gotten on the spot, with the case number and the accepting unit written down; ② when the deadline has been passed with no result having been produced, progress is to be asked about within those limits — ask "which stage is the case at", not "why is nobody dealing with me"; ③ when the notice of non-acceptance has arrived, the reasons are to be read first, application for reconsideration is to be made within 7 days and for review within another 7, and at the same time case-opening supervision can be raised with the people's procuratorate — the three routes do not conflict. A rude reception and whether the case gets handled are two different things; the former goes through an inspection complaint — it is not to be allowed to derail the latter. Lost property and neighbor disputes were never criminal cases in the first place: they are handled by the public security organ as administrative cases or through mediation, or merely registered — that is not to be read as "nobody cares about my report". For the payment-stop process after being scammed, see item 2 of this section; for online mobs, item 35 of this section

### 4. Do not eat candy or snacks from strangers, do not drink a beverage that left your sight, do not accept a vape cartridge handed to you
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; anything handed to you is to be refused, and a swap for a fresh drink is to be made if yours has ever left your sight
- In plain terms: Drugs today do not look like drugs — "head-spinning" e-cigarettes laced with synthetic cannabinoids can be made in all colors and flavors and look basically identical to ordinary e-cigarettes, being handed around to be tried in bars, KTVs, and hotels. It is the case that luring someone into taking drugs means 10 to 15 days of detention and a fine of 1,000 to 5,000 yuan; a person who has been tricked into taking them is also detained 10 to 15 days and can be fined up to 3,000 yuan, and addiction brings 3 years of community-based rehabilitation to be undergone. If a drink has left your sight, a swap for a new one is to be made.
- Benefit: Drugs today do not look like drugs. Synthetic cannabinoid substances have been controlled as an entire class since July 1, 2021, having been mixed into vape oil to make "head-spinning" e-cigarettes. In a case reported by the Supreme People's Procuratorate, it was described by investigators that the vape oil was able to "become various colors and various flavors with added food coloring" and as "basically identical in appearance to ordinary e-cigarettes"; promotion of it to friends and acquaintances was done by sellers in bars, KTVs, and hotels and others were induced to use it, and in that locality's drug-use cases handled that year minors were found to make up nearly forty percent of users. Etomidate was added to the Schedule II psychotropic substances list on October 1, 2023. It is the case that deceiving someone into taking drugs is itself an offense: inducing, instigating, deceiving, or coercing another person to smoke or inject drugs means 10 to 15 days of detention and a fine of 1,000 to 5,000 yuan; where a crime is constituted, the sentence is up to 3 years, 3 to 7 years in serious circumstances, 3 to 10 years for coercion, and heavier for offenses against minors. The consequences are had by the person deceived: smoking or injecting drugs means 10 to 15 days of detention and a fine of up to 3,000 yuan (in minor circumstances, up to 5 days of detention or a fine of up to 1,000 yuan), and possibly an order barring entry to entertainment venues for 6 months to 1 year; those addicted are ordered into 3 years of community-based rehabilitation to be undergone, and those who refuse it or use again during it face 2 years of compulsory isolation rehabilitation, extendable by at most 1 more year (nationwide, Public Security Administration Punishments Law, from January 2026)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 最高人民检察院 (2021). 江苏苏州吴江区：办案检察官揭秘披着潮流外衣的新型毒品. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202110/t20211011_531831.shtml>；国家药监局、公安部、国家卫生健康委 (2023). 关于调整麻醉药品和精神药品目录的公告（2023 年第 120 号）. <https://yjj.sh.gov.cn/qtgzwj/20230911/3b612c94e35b4b63abba314c972a2593.html>（上海市药监局转载，原文页 nmpa.gov.cn 在本机返回 412）；全国人大常委会 (2025). 治安管理处罚法（2025 年修订，第八十四、八十五条）. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>；全国人大 (1997). 刑法（第三百五十三条）. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>；全国人大常委会 (2007). 禁毒法（第三十三、三十八、四十七条）. <http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/post_2520706.html>（广东省人民政府转载）
- Notes: It is not only for entertainment venues that this holds: the same logic applies at school gates, at friends' gatherings, and on long-distance buses, whether the item handed over is candy, a drink, or a vape cartridge. Drugging is often followed by robbery, sexual assault, and extortion; no published official statistics are had on that part — it is to be judged by experience. Far less is involved in the swapping of a drink that has left your sight than in the pursuing of it afterwards. For what is to be done when someone produces unknown powder, pills, or a cartridge in a venue, see item 3 of this section; for carrying things for other people, see item 27 of section 8.

### 38. Do not hand money or gift cards to the people handling your case or enforcing the law: bribery gets you sentenced too, and bribing supervisory, law-enforcement, or judicial personnel is punished more heavily
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; it is simply the not doing of it
- In plain terms: "spend a little money to smooth things over" constitutes a separate crime with respect to the Criminal Law, and it is not only the person taking the money who is caught. The crime of offering bribes is defined as the giving of property to state functionaries so as to obtain improper benefits; the sentencing was reworked into three tiers by Criminal Law Amendment XII, in force from March 1, 2024: up to 3 years plus a fine; 3 to 10 years where the bribery to obtain improper benefits is serious in circumstances or causes major losses to state interests; over 10 years or life imprisonment where especially serious, plus a fine or confiscation of property. Seven aggravating circumstances are also listed by it, two of which are aimed straight at this kind of scene: "bribing supervisory, administrative law-enforcement, or judicial personnel", and bribing in fields such as education, healthcare, social security, food and drugs, and work safety while carrying out unlawful or criminal activity. Two openings are left by the law: where property is given because extortion was undergone, without an improper benefit being obtained, it is not bribery; and a lighter or mitigated punishment can be brought by the voluntarily confessing of the bribery before being prosecuted, with a mitigated or exempted punishment where the crime is minor and a key role was played by you in the cracking of a major case.
- Benefit: Criminal Law article 389: "giving property to a state functionary to obtain improper benefits is the crime of offering bribes"; "in economic exchanges, giving property to a state functionary in violation of state regulations, where the amount is relatively large, or giving kickbacks or handling fees to a state functionary under various names in violation of state regulations, is punished as offering bribes"; "giving property to a state functionary because of extortion, without obtaining an improper benefit, is not bribery". Criminal Law article 390 (as amended by Criminal Law Amendment XII, in force from March 1, 2024): "whoever commits the crime of offering bribes is sentenced to up to three years of fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention, plus a fine; where the bribery to obtain improper benefits is serious in circumstances, or causes major losses to state interests, 3 to 10 years of fixed-term imprisonment plus a fine; where the circumstances are especially serious, or the losses to state interests especially major, 10 years or more of fixed-term imprisonment or life imprisonment, plus a fine or confiscation of property"; the seven aggravating circumstances are "(1) bribing repeatedly or bribing multiple people; (2) a state functionary offering bribes; (3) offering bribes in national key projects or major projects; (4) offering bribes to obtain promotion or adjustment of position or rank; (5) bribing supervisory, administrative law-enforcement, or judicial personnel; (6) offering bribes in fields such as the eco-environment, finance, work safety, food and drugs, disaster prevention and relief, social security, education, and healthcare while carrying out unlawful or criminal activity; (7) using proceeds of unlawful activity to offer bribes"; the final paragraph of the aforementioned article: "where the bribe-giver voluntarily confesses the bribery before being prosecuted, a lighter or mitigated punishment may be given; among these, where the crime is minor, or where they played a key role in breaking open or solving a major case, or performed a major meritorious service, a mitigated or exempted punishment may be given" (nationwide)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大常委会. 中华人民共和国刑法（经刑法修正案十一修正的整合文本）第三百八十九条. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>；全国人大常委会 (2023). 中华人民共和国刑法修正案（十二）（第五项，修改刑法第三百九十条；自 2024 年 3 月 1 日起施行）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081818c3ce31f018cb6a6bc412f55>
- Notes: the beneficiary is yourself. What is aimed at by this item is the thought that "a little bribery can buy exemption from punishment": colleagues, case ledgers, surveillance, and inspection bodies are had by the person opposite you; that which you hand over is evidence against him when he is investigated, and evidence of your own crime — and this category of bribery is situated squarely in the expressly aggravated tier. If favors are really demanded by the other side, the correct move is the channels from the previous item — the case-acceptance receipt and paperwork are to be kept, and a report is to be made to the inspection body or the discipline inspection and supervisory organs; the exemption condition in Criminal Law article 389(3) is "extorted and without obtaining an improper benefit" — once use is made of it to get something that could not otherwise have been gotten, that condition no longer holds. Cash gifts in hospitals are governed by a different set of rules; see item 12 of section 24

### 9. If you are diagnosed with gout, take urate-lowering medication long term and keep blood urate below 360 µmol/L
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=少 毅力=是 收益=大 口径=死亡率 -->
- Cost: a few to a few dozen yuan a month for allopurinol; blood urate checks are to be done every few weeks at first so that the dose can be adjusted, then every few months once stability has been reached; a flare-prevention drug is to be taken alongside for the first 3 to 6 months
- In plain terms: the right way to play gout is that urate be kept below 360 all the time, not that painkillers be taken only when it hurts. In a UK trial of 517 people, the target was hit after two years by 95% of those on this treat-to-target dosing scheme, against 30% under usual care. In follow-up questionnaires, the median number of flares reported over the past year was 0 in the on-target group and 1 under usual care. Even after the target has been reached, a stop cannot be put to it: in one group of patients who had been stable long term and whose urate did not rebound after the drug had been stopped, only 27 of 211 went five years without a single flare having been had. Help is given by watching your diet but only a little — blood urate just 1.6 mg/dL lower is had by people who limit or quit alcohol than by those who don't, and it is raised by 0.16 mg/dL by one beer, so the reaching of the target by way of eating is not realistic.
- Benefit: randomized controlled trial (517 adults with a flare in the past 12 months, nurse-led patient education plus a treat-to-target dosing algorithm versus usual general-practice care): a proportion with blood urate <360 µmol/L (6 mg/dL) at 2 years of 95% versus 30% was had, RR 3.18 (95% CI 2.42–4.18), P<0.0001; flare frequency, tophi, and quality-of-life secondary outcomes in year 2 were all better than usual care, at £5,066 per quality-adjusted life year gained. Follow-up study of the same trial (438 people sent questionnaires, 82% returned): median self-reported flares over the past 12 months 0 (interquartile range 0–0) in the on-target group versus 1 (0–3) under usual care, P<0.001; adjusted RR 1.19 (1.09–1.30) for still being on urate-lowering therapy. American College of Rheumatology 2020 gout guideline strong recommendation: urate-lowering therapy is to be started for anyone with subcutaneous tophi, radiographic damage attributable to gout, or flares at least twice a year, a treat-to-target strategy being utilized with serial blood-urate monitoring and a target <6 mg/dL; allopurinol is first line (including stage 3 or higher chronic kidney disease) at a starting dose ≤100 mg/day, with anti-inflammatory prophylaxis given alongside at initiation for at least 3 to 6 months. Case series cited by the same guideline: among patients by whom the drug had been stopped after long-term good control and whose urate stayed <7 mg/dL after stopping, no flare during 5 years of follow-up was had by only 13% (27/211). Dietary effect sizes: blood urate 1.6 mg/dL lower is had in people who limit or avoid alcohol than in those who do not, blood urate being raised by 0.16 mg/dL by one serving of beer; even smaller effects are had from healthy diet, Mediterranean diet, and DASH diet
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Doherty M, Jenkins W, Richardson H, et al. (2018). Efficacy and cost-effectiveness of nurse-led care involving education and engagement of patients and a treat-to-target urate-lowering strategy versus usual care for gout: a randomised controlled trial. Lancet, 392(10156), 1403-1412. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(18)32158-5>；Abhishek A, Jenkins W, La-Crette J, Fernandes G, Doherty M (2020). Nurse-led care is preferred over GP-led care of gout and improves gout outcomes: results of Nottingham Gout Treatment Trial follow-up study. Rheumatology, 59(3), 575-579. <https://doi.org/10.1093/rheumatology/kez333>；FitzGerald JD, Dalbeth N, Mikuls T, et al. (2020). 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout. Arthritis Care & Research, 72(6), 744-760. <https://doi.org/10.1002/acr.24180>
- Notes: **Han Chinese should be tested for HLA-B\*5801 before taking allopurinol**: carrier frequency of this allele is 7.4% in Han, Korean, and Thai people versus 0.7% in white and Hispanic people; Asians and Black people face 3 times the risk of allopurinol hypersensitivity syndrome (in severe cases widespread skin sloughing, which can be fatal) compared with white people, and a conditional recommendation for testing before prescribing in these two groups is given by the guideline above. **Flares are actually triggered more easily when urate lowering is started**, which is why anti-inflammatory prophylaxis is strongly recommended by the guideline for the first 3 to 6 months — "it hurt more after I started the urate drug, so I stopped" is the way this fails most commonly; when it hurts, the right move is that an anti-inflammatory be added as directed, not that the urate-lowering drug be stopped. The target is phrased differently by different bodies: <6 mg/dL is about 360 µmol/L, and µmol/L is what is mostly used by Chinese lab reports. High urate found on a checkup with never a flare is a different matter — see section 6, item 18; sugary drinks and alcohol are covered in section 2, items 3, 16, 24

### 11. If treatment leaves a lasting functional impairment, apply for a disability certificate at the county-level disabled persons' federation where your household is registered
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=中 毅力=些 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- Cost: no fee is carried by the certificate itself; the assessment fee and photo fee are in principle to be paid by the applicant, with waivers available for those in difficulty; your ID card, household register, and 3 two-inch photos with a white background are to be brought to the county-level disabled persons' federation at your registered household; after a passing assessment has been had, the result is posted publicly in the village (community) for 5 working days, and the review is finished by the federation within 10 working days
- In plain terms: the disability certificate is the gateway to disability benefits, not a proof of injury. Seven categories are covered by it — vision, hearing, speech, physical, intellectual, mental, and multiple — each graded 1 to 4, it being assessed against the national standard. The process is one in which application is made, acceptance is had, assessment is done at a designated institution, public posting is carried out, review and approval are gone through, and then the certificate is issued; it is valid for ten years and renewed free at expiry. If qualification is not had, qualification is not had — this is not something that can be fixed by an acquaintance. If the condition later changes, application for reassessment can be made; if disagreement with the conclusion is had, application can be made to the city-level federation for re-assessment within ten working days.
- Benefit: the disability certificate "is the lawful credential for determining that a person is a person with a disability and their disability category and grade, and an important basis for persons with disabilities to enjoy the preferential policies of the state and local governments according to law"; the assessment standard is the national standard《Classification and Grading of Disabilities of Persons with Disabilities》(GB/T 26341-2010); application is voluntary and managed locally, and all seven categories — vision, hearing, speech, physical, intellectual, mental, and multiple — may apply, with grades 1 through 4; applications, acceptance, and issuance are handled by the county-level federation, based on the assessment conclusion of a hospital or professional institution designated by the province; conclusions meeting the standard are posted publicly in the village (community) for five working days, and "the review is completed within ten working days" by the county-level federation; "no fee is charged for issuing the disability certificate," with assessment and photo costs "in principle borne by the applicant personally; localities with the means may subsidize them from local finances, and fee reductions or waivers should be coordinated with relevant departments for applicants in special difficulty"; valid for ten years and renewed free at expiry; reassessment may be applied for by those whose disability category or grade changes; re-assessment within ten working days may be applied for to the prefecture-level federation by those who dispute the assessment conclusion, and remaining disputes are decided finally by the provincial disability-assessment expert committee (nationwide, effective January 1, 2018)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 中国残疾人联合会、国家卫生和计划生育委员会 (2017). 中华人民共和国残疾人证管理办法（2017 年 5 月 27 日发布，2018 年 1 月 1 日施行；第二、三、五、七、九、十七、十九、二十二、二十五条）. <https://www.bdpf.org.cn/cms68/web1459/subject/n1/n1459/n1508/n1509/n1512/c68465/content.html>
- Notes: the arithmetic is to be done before a decision on whether to apply: no money is paid directly by the certificate itself; what is unlocked by it are the two subsidies for persons with disabilities (a living subsidy for disabled people in minimum-livelihood-guarantee households, and a care subsidy for grade 1–2 people needing long-term care — see section 7, item 9), plus local benefits for rehabilitation, assistive devices, taxes, employment, and transport, by which wide variation is had from province to province — the local federation's website is to be checked before a decision on whether to make the trip. It, the forensic impairment grading, and the work-injury labor-capacity assessment are three separate systems that are not substitutable for one another (see item 10). The certificate is for the holder's use only and lending it out is not allowed; it is cancelled if the standard is no longer met by the disability, and reapplication within one year is not allowed to a cancelled holder. Multiple disabilities are graded by the most severe category.

### 31. Before buying big-ticket items, check national spot-check bulletins, CCC certification and energy-efficiency labels
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- Cost: no money; a few minutes are to be spent in the checking of the State Administration for Market Regulation and Certification and Accreditation Administration websites
- In plain terms: in 2024, 25,250 product batches were covered by national spot checks, with 14.3% found to have failed; e-commerce channels were where it was worse — 23.5% of 7,297 batches were found to have failed, versus 15.1% in physical stores. A few minutes are to be spent before a big purchase in the checking of the spot-check bulletins and the verifying of the CCC certificate, and it is to be made sure that the energy-efficiency label is there where it is required.
- Benefit: 25,250 product batches were covered by the 2024 national supervision spot checks, with a failure rate of 14.3% being had; 7,297 batches were accounted for by e-commerce channels, with a 23.5% failure rate being recorded, up 1.8 percentage points from the previous year, while 8,055 batches were had by physical stores with a 15.1% failure rate; the authenticity of Compulsory Product Certification (CCC) certificates can be checked in the "Certification Results" section of the Certification and Accreditation Administration website; energy-efficiency labels are mandatorily managed by product catalog, and the efficiency grade, efficiency indicators and an efficiency information code are what must be included by labels — the forging, misusing or omitting of a required label is punished under the Energy Conservation Law (nationwide)
- Evidence grade: B
- Sources: 市场监管总局 (2025). 关于 2024 年产品质量国家监督抽查情况的通报. <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zljds/art/2025/art_02676c16ac634fd9a48ec6ea10eb000d.html>；国家认监委. 官网「认证结果」查询入口. <https://www.cnca.gov.cn/> ；国家发展改革委、国家质检总局 (2016). 能源效率标识管理办法（令第 35 号，第三、七、二十七条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-11/30/content_5713245.htm>
- Notes: spot checks are regulatory sampling, not the market-wide pass rate, and ranking by them of platforms cannot be done; no research is had on "how much fewer shoddy goods you buy by checking," hence the B. The CNCA query platform cx.cnca.cn was not opened during the verification done for this section; the entrance on the cnca.gov.cn homepage is to be used. Spot-check bulletin figures are updated yearly — the latest issue is to be checked when they are used.

### 7. Don't withdraw money from a bank card you found; contact the owner or hand a found phone or wallet to the police instead of pocketing it
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- Cost: 0 yuan; one phone call is to be made, or a trip to the police station taken
- In plain terms: it is the case that keeping found property for yourself, refusing to hand it over when the amount is relatively large, means under 2 years, or 2 to 5 years for huge amounts. Worse is had when money is withdrawn from a found card at an ATM — it is counted as the fraudulent using of another person's credit card: under 5 years plus a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan for relatively large amounts, 5 to 10 years plus a fine of 50,000 to 500,000 yuan for huge amounts; and the filing of this kind is done by the police directly, with no suing needing to be done by the owner.
- Benefit: lost property that has been found must be returned to the rights holder, with timely notice being given to collect it or delivery being made to public security and other departments; the converting of another person's forgotten property to one's own and the refusing to surrender it when the amount is relatively large constitutes the crime of embezzlement — under 2 years, or 2 to 5 years for huge amounts; the using of another person's found credit card at an ATM counts as "fraudulently using another person's credit card," and where a crime is formed it is handled as credit card fraud — under 5 years plus a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan for relatively large amounts, or 5 to 10 years plus a fine of 50,000 to 500,000 yuan for huge amounts or other serious circumstances (nationwide)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: 全国人大 (2020). 民法典（第三百一十四条）. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>；全国人大 (2020). 刑法（根据刑法修正案（十一）修正，第一百九十六、二百七十条）. <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>；最高人民检察院 (2008). 关于拾得他人信用卡并在自动柜员机（ATM 机）上使用的行为如何定性问题的批复. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/flfg/sfjs/201208/t20120830_47871.shtml>
- Notes: it is the case that embezzlement is "handled only upon complaint" — the suing in court must be done by the owner themselves — but the withdrawing of money with a found card is a publicly prosecuted case that is filed by the police directly; the specific sums for "relatively large amounts" are set by judicial interpretation, which was not verified by this section. After found property has been handed in, storage costs are paid by the owner when it is collected (Civil Code Article 317).
